purpose: Lightweight immutable identity for a retrieved source document version used by canonical evidence.
rules: document_id is deterministic from the normalized source URL.
document_version_id is deterministic from normalized URL plus content hash.
content_hash is mandatory for all v0.5 canonical evidence snapshots.
A changed content hash creates a new document_version_id without changing document_id.
Document identity stores provenance only and is not a document management system.
